action: As Bell advises, be wary of unsolicited requests for personal information and of links or attachments in suspicious emails or texts, and check accounts regularly.
date_note: VOCM's article of 23 November is the first page found; it gives no earlier day that this summary relies on.
exec: Bell says an "agentic threat actor" accessed internal systems with customer personal information; the RCMP's cyber crime unit has been contacted.
plain: Bell says an intruder it calls an "agentic threat actor" got into some internal systems that held customers' personal information. It says bank and credit card numbers were not affected.

sources.name: VOCM: RCMP Investigating Bell Cybersecurity Incident

summary: VOCM reports that Bell says an "agentic threat actor" accessed some of its internal systems, including customers' personal information such as names, addresses and contact details. Bell says sensitive data such as bank account and credit card numbers was not compromised, and that it contained the incident and removed the threat actor. VOCM says the RCMP's cyber crime unit has been contacted; no one has claimed responsibility.
title: Bell says an "agentic threat actor" accessed internal systems with customer information; RCMP cyber crime unit contacted

validation.note: Only VOCM was read, relaying Bell's statement; Bell's own notice was not found in this run.
